frame: trunk_base = CAD guide frame, metres, x forward y left z up; position = lip-face centre on the fan axis; thrust_axis = unit direction of the force on the robot (exhaust is -thrust_axis)
source: extensions/flight-20261110/sim/flight.py FANS (from cad/flight_params.py: CANT_DEG, FAN_X, FAN_Y, LIP_TOP_Z, FAN lip_od); force applied as Tf[i] * (R @ a) at xpos[trunk] + R @ p (flight.py lines 505-509)

lag.model: first-order on rotor speed w: dw = (w_ss - w) dt / tau, w_ss = clip(u,0,1) W_REF v_bus/V_REF; thrust T = T_REF scale (w/W_REF)^2 (flight.py FanSet.step)
lag.note: FanSet default tau=0.10 and flight.py --tau default 0.10 s; tau_down defaults to tau. Spin-up time constant of rotor speed, estimate (no bench measurement)

spin_reaction: body torque about the axis = -spin x 0.3 x rotor drag torque (flight.py FanSet resid 0.3)
